DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 虫の観察会に遅れました。先に虫を捕まえてから参加すればいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅刻した虫観察会へ事前採集して参加すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am late for the insect observation event. Should I catch some insects first and then join?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should collect insects before joining an insect observation event you are late for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用観察会は、捕獲せずその場所で見る内容です。お名前を受付で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This educational observation event involves watching insects where they are without catching them. Let us confirm your name at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 捕まえる会だと思って網を持ってきました。今日は使わずしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 捕獲の会と思い網を持参したが使用せず収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was an insect-catching event, so I brought a net. I will put it away and not use it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you brought a net because you thought the event involved catching insects, but will put it away without using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。団体はいま観察地点で説明を受けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. The group is currently listening to an explanation at the observation spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中から合流したいです。参加受付を済ませてから向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中合流を希望し先に参加受付を済ませると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to join them partway through. I will complete registration before going there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to join partway through and will register first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。案内係と一緒に進み、草むらへ一人で入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please go with the guide, and do not enter the grass on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもも一緒なので、係の方の後を二人で歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子供と二人で係員の後を歩き単独進入しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a child with me, so the two of us will walk behind the guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you and your child will walk behind the staff member rather than enter alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流後は担当に、遅れて来た二人だとお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you join the group, please tell the person in charge that you are the two late arrivals.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 網は使わず二人で合流し、どこを見るか担当の説明を聞いて観察します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 網を使わず合流して担当説明を聞き現地観察すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will join without using the net, listen to the person in charge explain where to look, and observe the insects there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will join without using the net, listen to the staff member's explanation, and observe insects on site. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内係はこちらです。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The guide is over here. Please enjoy the event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出発まで十分あります。トイレに行きたいのですが、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出発まで十分ある状態でトイレの場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are ten minutes until departure. I would like to use the restroom. Could you tell me where it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where the restroom is when there are ten minutes before departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内では改札の手前です。荷物もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to this guide, it is before the ticket gates. Do you have luggage with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きな鞄があります。ここへ置いたままにせず、持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きい鞄を放置せず持って移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a large bag. I will take it with me rather than leave it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will take your large bag with you instead of leaving it unattended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では移動に必要な時間も考えてください。列車が待つとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please also allow for the time needed to get there. We cannot promise that the train will wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで走るより、次の列車も調べてから行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 走らず次便の情報も確認してから行きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than hurry and run, I would like to check the next train before going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the next service before going, rather than running. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の便の案内はこちらです。ご予定に合うか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the information for the next service. Let us check whether it fits your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次でも約束には間に合います。連れには一便遅くなると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便でも約束に間に合い同行者へ一便後になると連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even the next one will get me there in time for my appointment. I will tell my companion I will be one train later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the next train will still get you to your appointment on time and that you will tell your companion you will take one service later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。切符の条件も必要なら窓口で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If necessary, please also check your ticket's conditions at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鞄を持ってトイレへ行き、戻って表示を確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物とともにトイレへ行き戻った表示確認後に乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take my bag to the restroom, come back, and check the display before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take your luggage to the restroom, return, and board after checking the display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。どうぞお気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What kind of help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 避難訓練に参加したいです。仕事の後で途中から来てもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避難訓練へ勤務後途中参加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to participate in the evacuation drill. May I join partway through after work?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may join the evacuation drill partway through after work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この行事は訓練です。実際に今避難する指示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This event is a drill. It is not an instruction to evacuate now in an actual emergency.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、来週の練習として参加したいです。開始には間に合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の避難指示でなく翌週訓練への参加希望と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I would like to join next week's practice. I will not make it in time for the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you want to participate in next week's drill, rather than respond to a current evacuation instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中参加の受付は担当へ確認します。到着予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the person in charge about registration for late arrivals. Please tell me your expected arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開始から三十分後です。集団を探して勝手に合流せず、受付へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分遅れて到着し勝手に合流せず受付へ行くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thirty minutes after the start. I will go to reception rather than look for the group and join on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will arrive thirty minutes late and go to reception rather than join the group without checking in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その予定を担当に伝えます。持ち物の案内もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that plan on to the person in charge. The information about what to bring is also here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普段の通勤鞄で来るので、必要な物を前日に入れておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通勤鞄で来るため必要物を前日に用意したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will be coming with my usual work bag, so I would like to pack what I need the day before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to prepare the necessary items the day before because you will come with your work bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内の項目を確認し、不明な物は担当へ尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the items in the guide and ask the person in charge about anything you are unsure of.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 到着時刻を伝えて受付方法を聞き、訓練の持ち物を準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着予定の連絡と受付確認と訓練用持物準備をすると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them when I expect to arrive, ask about registration, and prepare the things I need for the drill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will communicate your expected arrival, check registration arrangements, and prepare the items for the drill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you to the counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入院の荷物に仕事のパソコンを入れました。受付で預けられるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入院荷物の仕事用パソコンを受付へ預けられるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I packed my work laptop with my things for hospitalization. Can I leave it at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can leave the work laptop in your hospital luggage at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貴重品の預かりは担当へ確認が必要です。入院中に使う予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check with the person in charge about storing valuables. Do you plan to use it while you are in hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使う予定はありません。鞄に入ったまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入院中未使用予定で鞄に残っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not plan to use it. I brought it because it was still in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not use it during your hospital stay and that it had been left in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付へ置いたままにはせず、不要な荷物の扱いを考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than leave it at reception, let us consider how to handle the belongings you do not need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連れがいるので、パソコンだけ持ち帰ってもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者へ不要パソコンのみ持帰りを頼みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have someone with me, so I would like them to take just the laptop home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you would like your companion to take home only the laptop you do not need. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の物を渡す際、中身を一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you hand over your belongings, please check the contents together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 充電器も同じ袋にあります。書類は必要なので、パソコンとは分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 充電器は同袋だが必要書類は別に残すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The charger is in the same pouch too. I need the documents, so I will separate them from the laptop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the charger is in the same pouch, but that you will keep the necessary documents separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。入院の書類まで持ち帰らないよう確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us make sure the hospital admission documents do not get taken home as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: パソコンと充電器を連れへ渡し、入院書類は自分で残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 機器二点だけ同行者へ渡し入院書類を自分で保持すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give my companion the laptop and charger and keep the hospital admission documents myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand only the two pieces of equipment to your companion and keep the admission documents yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。荷物が整理できましたら受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once you have sorted your belongings, we will continue the admission procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の搬入口に車が長く止まっていました。見たことを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 搬入口へ長く停車する車を勤務中に見たと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A car was parked for a long time at my workplace's delivery entrance. I would like to discuss what I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you saw a car parked for a long time at the delivery entrance while you were at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様はいま安全な場所ですね。何時ごろ見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are in a safe place now, correct? Around what time did you see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼の一時ごろです。私は店内から見たので、運転者の顔は見えませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時ごろ店内から見て運転者の顔は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around one in the afternoon. I saw it from inside the shop, so I could not see the driver's face.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw it from inside the shop at around one and did not see the driver's face. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車について、確かに見た特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there any features of the car that you definitely saw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い車でした。番号は遠くて読めず、数字は思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白い車で遠方の車両番号は読めなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was a white car. The license plate was too far away to read, so I cannot recall the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it was a white car and you could not read the license plate from a distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めなかった番号を推測する必要はありません。車が離れた場面は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You do not need to guess a plate number you could not read. Did you see the car leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ。作業に戻ったので、いつ離れたかもわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業へ戻り離れる場面と時刻は未確認だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I went back to work, so I do not know when it left either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you returned to work and did not see the car leave or confirm when it left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見た時刻と見ていない範囲を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask separately about the time you saw it and the things you did not see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白い車を一時ごろ店内から見た、と説明します。顔と番号は不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察時刻と白色だけ確かで顔と番号は不明と整理して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I saw a white car from inside the shop around one. I do not know the face or the license plate number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize your report by saying you are certain only of the observation time and white color, while the face and plate number are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。見た範囲を担当へ引き継ぎます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. I will pass what you actually saw to the person in charge. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本と服を同じ箱に入れましたが、動かすと本がずれます。梱包を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本と衣類が箱内で動くため発送前に梱包を直したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put books and clothes in the same box, but the books slide when I move it. I would like to redo the packing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about fixing the packing before shipping because books and clothing move inside the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ受付前ですね。箱の中にすき間がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not handed it over yet, correct? Is there empty space inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。本を上に置いたので、動くと服を押してしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上置き本が空間でずれ衣類を押すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I put the books on top, so when they shift, they press on the clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the books on top shift in the empty space and press against the clothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身が動かない形に整えましょう。二箱に分ける方法も考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us arrange things so the contents do not move. Splitting them into two boxes is another option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は一箱にまとめたいですが、重い本を底に置き直してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一箱希望で重い本を底へ移す案を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to keep it in one box today. May I move the heavy books to the bottom?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you prefer one box and ask about moving the heavy books to the bottom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配置と緩衝材を確認してください。箱自体が重さに合うかも担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the arrangement and cushioning material. The person in charge will also check whether the box itself is suitable for the weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に戻ってすき間を埋め、箱が弱ければ二箱に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅してすき間を埋め箱強度が足りなければ二箱にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go home and fill the gaps, and divide it into two boxes if this box is not strong enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will go home, fill the gaps, and use two boxes if the box is not strong enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付前に直すご予定ですね。最終の重さと大きさで方法を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you plan to fix it before handing it over. You can discuss a shipping method based on the final weight and dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は差し出さず、動かない梱包にしてから重さを測って持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日発送せず安定梱包と重量確認後に持参すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send it today. I will pack it so it does not move, weigh it, and then bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to ship it today and to bring it back after packing it securely and checking the weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備できましたらまたご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come and ask us again when it is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 振込先の支店名の読みがわかりません。漢字のまま確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない支店名を漢字のまま照合してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not know how to read the recipient branch's name. Could you check it as written in kanji?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to have a branch name you cannot read checked as written in kanji. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込先から受け取った情報をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the information you received from the transfer recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。漢字と支店番号が書いてあります。似た読みの候補はまだ選んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字と番号の情報があり似た読みの候補は未選択と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It has the kanji and branch number. I have not selected any similar-sounding candidate yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the kanji and branch number and have not selected a branch with a similar reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号も合わせて確認しましょう。支店の候補を読みだけで決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the number as well. Please do not choose a branch based only on how its name sounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この番号の支店名を照合したいです。読めない漢字は書いて示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支店番号と漢字を示して対応確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to match the branch name with this number. I will write out the kanji I cannot read to show you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the branch number and kanji and ask to confirm that they correspond. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当と照合できます。銀行名も同じ情報にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check it with the person in charge. Is the bank name included in the same information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、銀行名もあります。銀行を別に選んでしまわないよう順に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行名も提示し別銀行を選ばないよう順に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the bank name is there too. I will check each step so I do not select a different bank by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Also show the bank name and say that you will check in order to avoid choosing a different bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 銀行名、支店名と番号の対応を確認してから次へ進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us confirm that the bank name, branch name, and number match before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読めない名前を推測せず、情報の三点が一致してから送金の相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行名と支店名と番号一致後に送金相談を続けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not guess the name I cannot read. I will continue discussing the transfer once all three details agree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will continue discussing the transfer after confirming the bank name, branch name, and branch number all match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take you to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このかごに選んでいない商品があります。別の人のかごを持ったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未選択品がかごにあり他人のかごを持った可能性を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are items in this basket that I did not choose. I may have picked up someone else's basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that there are items you did not choose in the basket and that you may have taken another person's basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どの売場でかごを持ち直しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and in which section did you pick the basket back up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 野菜売場で隣に置いて、戻ったときです。私の袋は持っていますが、かごは違う気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 野菜売場で置いて持ち直し私物袋は本人だがかご不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I came back after putting it beside me in the vegetable section. I have my own bag, but I think the basket is different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you put down and picked up the basket in the vegetable section, and that your personal bag is yours but the basket is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では中身を入れ替えず、かご全体で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check the whole basket without swapping any contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分が選んだ物だけ抜こうとしましたが、まだ何も動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己選択品だけ抜きかけたが未移動だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was about to take out only the things I chose, but I have not moved anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you were about to remove just the items you chose but have not moved them yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままでお願いします。ご自身が選んだ品を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave it as it is. Tell me which items you selected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 牛乳と玉ねぎです。このかごには牛乳はありますが、玉ねぎはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 選んだ牛乳と玉ねぎのうち玉ねぎがないと具体的に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Milk and onions. There is milk in this basket, but no onions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify that of the milk and onions you chose, the onions are missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一品同じでも、同じかごとは限りません。売場の担当へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if one item is the same, that does not mean it is the same basket. I will inform the staff member for that section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このかごを持ったまま会計せず、取り違えた場所で担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確認のかごを会計せず売場担当の照合を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not check out with this basket. I will wait for the staff member to check it at the place where I mixed it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not pay for the unconfirmed basket and will wait for the section staff to compare it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check together here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩に来ましたが、列が急に走り出しそうです。ここは普通の通り道でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩で入った走り出す列が一般通路か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came for a walk, but this line looks as if it is about to start running. Is this a normal walkway?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a line you entered during your walk that is about to start running is a public passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この行事の参加者がスタートを待つ区域です。一般の散歩道は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is an area where participants in this event wait to start. The regular walking path is elsewhere.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行列に沿って歩けば出口へ行けると思って、入ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出口へ向かう行列と思い競技列へ入ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought following the line would take me to the exit, so I came in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered the competitors' line thinking it was a queue leading to the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 競技の列には入らず、こちらの一般通行用表示へ移りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not join the competitors' line. Let us move toward the sign for the public passage over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は参加者ではありません。列を横切らず、後ろから出てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 非参加者として列を横切らず後方へ出る方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am not a participant. May I leave from the back without crossing the line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: As a nonparticipant, ask how to leave from the rear without crossing the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員が誘導しますので、その案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will guide you, so please follow their directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は一人です。荷物を持って、係員の誘導を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人で荷物を持ち係員誘導を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am alone. I will keep my belongings with me and wait for the staff member's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are alone, have your belongings with you, and will wait for staff guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。一般通行の道へ出たら、出口表示を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once you are on the public path, you can check the signs for the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 参加列から係員の案内で出て、一般道で出口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加列を誘導で出て一般道の出口表示へ進むと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the participants' line with staff guidance and head to the exit along the public path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will leave the participants' line under staff guidance and follow the exit signs on the public path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will guide you from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 混む列車に乗ります。大きなリュックを背負ったまま扉の前に立ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混雑列車で大リュックを背負い扉前に立てるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking a crowded train. May I stand in front of the doors with my large backpack still on my back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about standing by the doors on a crowded train while wearing a large backpack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗降の妨げにならない位置を選び、荷物も周囲に当たらないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please choose a position that does not obstruct people boarding or alighting, and make sure your luggage does not hit those around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐには降りません。扉の前を空けて、リュックを手元へ下ろします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: すぐに降りないので扉を空けリュックを手元へ下ろすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not getting off soon. I will keep the doorway clear and take off my backpack to hold it in front of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are not getting off soon, so you will clear the doorway and lower your backpack to hold it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。車内の案内にも従ってください。通路へ荷物を置きっぱなしにしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please follow the instructions inside the train too. Do not leave your luggage in the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ったまま中へ移りたいとき、「すみません、奥へ行きます」と声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を持って奥へ行く時の声掛けを自分から述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I want to move farther inside while holding it, I will say, 'Excuse me, I am moving farther in.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say how you will let others know when you move farther inside with your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように伝えられます。人を押さず、進める状態か確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can say that. Please check whether there is room to move without pushing anyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 降りるときも、先に周りへ知らせてから扉へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 降車前も周囲へ知らせて扉へ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I get off too, I will let the people around me know before moving toward the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will also notify those around you before moving toward the door to get off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。停車中の乗り降りを妨げないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us avoid obstructing people boarding and alighting while the train is stopped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: リュックを下ろして持ち、近い駅で降りない間は扉前をふさぎません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: リュックを持ち近い降車でない間は扉前を空けると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take off and hold my backpack, and keep the doorway clear while I am not getting off at a nearby station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will hold your backpack and keep the doorway clear when you are not getting off soon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take care when boarding.
